phrases.text: Measure 2 is about free school meals.
Today, students apply for federal free and reduced meals and must meet income requirements.
Public schools would have to serve every student breakfast and lunch at no cost.
Private and tribal schools could choose to take part.
The state would pay what federal funding does not, from a source the Legislature names or else Legacy Fund earnings.
The ballot language estimates $124.3 million to $134.3 million for the 2027 to 2029 two-year budget, adjusted yearly for inflation after that.
North Dakota's guide includes no official argument against the measure.
North Dakota's guide includes no official argument for the measure.
A yes vote means you support state funding for school breakfast and lunch.
A no vote means you do not support state meal funding beyond the current free and reduced meal program.
